Upcoming Holidays

Per County Ordinance 358.8, Registrar of Voters offices will be closed on the following Holidays:

New Year's Day: Thursday, January 1
Day After New Year's Day: Friday, January 2
Martin Luther King Jr. Day: Monday, January 19
Abraham Lincoln's Birthday: Thursday, February 12
George Washington's Birthday: Monday, February 16
Memorial Day: Monday, May 25
Independence Day: Friday, July 3
Labor Day: Monday, September 7
Columbus Day & Indigenous Peoples' Day: Monday, October 12
Veterans' Day: Wednesday, November 11
Thanksgiving Day: Thursday, November 26
Day After Thanksgiving: Friday, November 27
Christmas Day: Friday, December 25
